# Alpha Surveillance — Comprehensive AI System Documentation

## Overview

Alpha Surveillance (https://surveillance.alpha-devs.cloud) is an autonomous, enterprise-grade AI computer vision and surveillance orchestration platform designed for real-time safety compliance, environmental hazard detection, and operational intelligence.

By combining existing RTSP camera feeds with state-of-the-art vision models (deep convolutional networks and YOLO-based detectors), Alpha Surveillance eliminates manual CCTV monitoring and proactively flags safety non-compliance, unauthorized perimeter breaches, and workplace hazards.

## System Capabilities

### 1. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Compliance
- Real-time object detection and classification for:
  - Safety Helmets / Hard Hats
  - High-Visibility Safety Vests (ANSI Class 2 / Class 3)
  - Safety Glasses and Face Shields
  - Heavy-Duty Work Gloves and Protective Footwear
  - Food Safety Gear: Hairnets, Beard Nets, Food-Grade Gloves, Aprons
- Confidence scoring and multi-frame temporal confirmation to minimize false positives.
- Automatic creation of photographic violation proof with annotated bounding boxes.

### 2. Ergonomics & Biomechanical Hazard Monitoring
- Real-time pose estimation tracking spine angle, knee flexion, and load lift posture.
- Immediate detection of dangerous lifting posture (e.g., bending from the back instead of the knees) to mitigate chronic occupational injuries.

### 3. Real-Time RTSP & WebRTC Streaming Architecture
- Low-latency RTSP ingestion engine handling multi-camera parallel streams.
- Edge-to-cloud frame processing with intelligent motion gating and interleaved sampling.
- WebRTC (WHEP) sub-second live streaming playback directly embedded in tenant dashboards via Cloudflare Stream.

### 4. Enterprise Multi-Tenancy & RBAC
- SuperAdmin control plane for system-wide tenant management, model deployment, and server resource allocation.
- Isolated Tenant organizations with dedicated locations, camera mappings, employee rosters, and custom violation threshold rules.
- Cryptographic JWT security, salted password hashing, and Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification.

### 5. Time-Series Audit Logging & Analytics
- TimescaleDB time-series storage recording every event, stream heartbeat, and violation incident.
- Exportable compliance audits in PDF format for regulatory inspection (OSHA, EHS, ISO 45001).
- Statistical trend analysis (hourly incident rates, camera breakdown, compliance scoring).
